additional_info.subject: Note to L2
additional_info.body:
Empty Charger Alive Notification"
could potentially be a message from a device telling you that while the charger is technically still connected or operational, it’s not providing the expected power (i.e., "empty"). This could be related to issues like faulty cables, power source problems, or an uncharged or malfunctioning power adapter.
